component: LOS (line of sight); negative = away from satellite = subsidence
source: NISAR L2 GUNW (PROVISIONAL, CRID P05023) via ASF DAAC, track 76 descending frame 71; https://nisar-docs.asf.alaska.edu/gunw
notes: Cumulative LOS displacement relative to 2026-06-19, sum of 9 consecutive pairs (2026-06-19_2026-07-01, 2026-07-01_2026-07-13, 2026-07-13_2026-07-25, 2026-07-25_2026-08-18, 2026-08-18_2026-08-30, 2026-08-30_2026-09-11, 2026-09-11_2026-09-23, 2026-09-23_2026-10-05, 2026-10-05_2026-10-17). Phase to cm with -lambda/(4*pi), lambda from each file's centerFrequency. Masks: coherence >= 0.3, connectedComponents != 0, isolated patches < 200 px (1.3 km2) removed (unwrapping-error guard), pixels deviating > lambda/4 (half a phase cycle) from their 720 m tile median removed, |pair| > 15.0 cm removed; pixel shown only if valid in every pair. All pairs referenced to the same window at 108.4882E 34.3029N. The ionosphere phase screen shipped in each GUNW was subtracted. A best-fit plane was removed from each pair (long-wavelength atmospheric residual; this can also remove part of any valley-wide tilt). Troposphere and solid-earth-tide layers were NOT applied; residual atmospheric noise of a few cm per pair is expected.

reference_point.source: Shi et al. 2020 reports the Xingping reference location as no-deformation; UNGEGN city-coordinate anchor (ID 2459), with local pixel selected by coherence

quality_note: NISAR L2 GUNW CRID P05023 provisional products only; calibration and validation are carried out by NASA-JPL/ISRO.

reference_anchor.window: 7x7 common-valid pixels; nearest high-coherence window within 3 km of source locality
